package razorpay

import (
	"bytes"
	"testing"
)

func TestPaystableProbeChecksUnicodeAndTampering(t *testing.T) {
	p := New(testConfig())
	body := buildEnvelope("subscription.charged", 1700000000, `{"subscription":{"entity":{"id":"sub_probe","notes":{"description":"नमस्ते ₹"}}}}`)
	headers := webhookHeaders(body, testConfig().WebhookSecret, "evt_probe")

	event, err := p.VerifyWebhook(body, headers)
	if err != nil || event.ProviderEventID != "evt_probe" {
		t.Fatalf("the signed Unicode payload failed: %v", err)
	}
	tampered := bytes.Replace(body, []byte("₹"), []byte("$"), 1)
	if _, err := p.VerifyWebhook(tampered, headers); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("the changed Unicode payload kept the original signature")
	}
	if _, err := p.VerifyWebhook(body, webhookHeaders(body, testConfig().WebhookSecret, "")); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("the payload passed without an event ID")
	}
}
